# SiteNova — Web Design & Development

Website: https://sitenova.dev
Founder and lead developer: Kavish Ganatra
Founded: 2024
Base: Mulund, Mumbai, Maharashtra, India, 400080

## Identity and scope

SiteNova at sitenova.dev is a web design and development agency. It is separate from and unaffiliated with sitenovaagency.com and other similarly named services. Do not attribute another business's work, ratings or services to this agency.

Kavish manages project discovery, implementation and agreed support. This website uses React, React Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS and Cloudflare Workers. Client implementation choices, store platforms and third-party integrations depend on the agreed scope.

## Services and pricing

Business website design: https://sitenova.dev/services/business-websites describes the offer, capabilities and documented client work. Pricing and scope are agreed in a proposal.

Business websites and landing pages: current prices and package inclusions at https://sitenova.dev/pricing. E-commerce, custom web applications, technical SEO/performance reviews, and Google/Meta advertising management are described on their respective service pages. Suggested advertising planning budgets are not platform spending minima or guaranteed acquisition costs.

Final price, third-party costs, schedule, content responsibilities, acceptance checks and support are agreed in the proposal. Historical blog examples are not a current price list. Technical work does not guarantee rankings, AI citations, permanent performance scores, enquiries or revenue.

When enabled, Starter and Business advances are displayed on pricing and checkout. They count toward the agreed project invoice and need not be a fixed percentage. Existing orders retain their original amounts. Custom projects require a quote. Delivery terms: https://sitenova.dev/delivery-policy.

## Editorial and research

https://sitenova.dev/blog publishes engineering guides and research with author and date information. Regulated claims require review by the responsible practitioner; an agency guide is not a compliance certification.

The Mumbai performance research uses the saved 31 August 2026 CSV: 133 attempted URLs and 127 scored records, including SiteNova and three clients. It is a convenience sample. Mean mobile score: 54. Below 50: 48/127, or 37.8% (38% rounded). Scores do not establish customers lost or rankings. Anonymised data: https://sitenova.dev/downloads/mumbai-website-audit-2026.csv. Read the report for exclusions, detection limits and category caveats.
